authority_snapshot_guard.competing_required_snapshots: If more than one unresolved required authority snapshot remains for the same authority role/jurisdiction and no exact producer-governed precedence resolves it, classify K07 before support counting.
authority_snapshot_guard.evaluation_order: INTEGRITY -> PRODUCER_PRECEDENCE -> APPLICABLE_NEGATIVE -> STATIC_AUTHORITY_COMPLETENESS -> TEMPORAL_SIGNATURE -> DUPLICATE_EQUIVALENCE -> SUPPORT_COUNT
authority_snapshot_guard.single_invocation_rule: One invocation binds exactly one V554 rule id/version/hash.

basis_typing.not_required_law: V553_NOT_REQUIRED_FOR_THIS_USE means only zero new V553 semantics for that use; it does not establish SCR554 temporal completeness, direct eligibility, positive authority, or F1.

duplicate_support.extra_v553_material: V553 material outside the exact invocation/rule-required temporal projection is reference-only and cannot manufacture independent support.
duplicate_support.no_op_v553_plus_direct: For SIG-001, direct basis is the only counting basis; no-op/irrelevant V553 objects contribute zero support and do not change F1 identity.

lineage_guard.material_lineage: Admission lineage may distinguish support only when it changes admitted proposition/use permission, source universe/risk set, estimand/measure authority, applicable negative/authority state, or another explicitly governed interpretation/lawful-use fact.
lineage_guard.provenance_only: Direct/V553 physical path, reissue/alias IDs, replay transport refs, and other nonmaterial lineage do not split support; preserve them as provenance_alias_refs/reference closure.
lineage_guard.rule: Only lineage distinctions that governing authority makes interpretation- or lawful-use-material participate in support equivalence.
lineage_guard.unknown_role: If lineage materiality cannot be established exactly, EQUIVALENCE_UNKNOWN -> FAIL_CLOSED.

m1_invocation_binding.different_use_rule: Different governed_use_id and independently bound invocation may reach a different route decision over the same admission.
m1_invocation_binding.same_demand_rule: A V553 limit/negative governs a V554 invocation only when exact governed_use/use-rule/signature/proposition/admission participation establishes the same semantic demand; labels/time proximity are insufficient.

mapping.NONCOMPARABLE: SCR554 K08 where temporal relational support is required

negative_precedence.other_invocation: A negative does not poison an independently identified use/signature whose predicates and authority independently pass.
negative_precedence.same_invocation: Applicable TEMPORAL_LIMIT/NONCOMPARABLE/missing required source-or-temporal authority blocks positive basis for that exact semantic demand; no signature downgrade/direct fallback.

replay.changed_material_hash_or_authority: new replay basis or fail-closed; never latest-substitute
replay.same_exact_heads_and_refs: same routing classification, projection, authority gate, equivalence grouping, support count and seam receipt

TEMPORAL_KEY.applicable_temporal_limit_negative_refs: associated TEMPORAL_LIMIT refs for the same governed invocation, if any
TEMPORAL_KEY.rule_relevant_temporal_semantic_refs: this TEMPORAL_KEY ref plus derivation_participant_refs required by invocation
TEMPORAL_KEY.source_relation_comparability_authority_: required external authority reached by temporal rule/authority_closure; if absent when required => limit/fail-closed
TEMPORAL_KEY.v553_object_content_hash: exported ref.content_hash; resolved object semantic_hash also verified

TEMPORAL_LIMIT.estimand_refs: missing_or_negative_authority_refs + participant admission/query closure where material
TEMPORAL_LIMIT.focal_structural_proposition_ref: immutable dereference through participant admission refs
TEMPORAL_LIMIT.measure_and_weight_authority_refs: missing_or_negative_authority_refs + participant admission/query closure where material
TEMPORAL_LIMIT.rule_relevant_temporal_semantic_refs: this limit ref + blocked_output_family + requested_operation + participant_refs
TEMPORAL_LIMIT.source_relation_comparability_authority_: missing_or_negative_authority_refs when source relation/comparability is the blocked prerequisite
TEMPORAL_LIMIT.v553_object_content_hash: exported ref.content_hash; resolved object.semantic_hash also verified

TEMPORAL_OBSERVATION.applicable_temporal_limit_negative_refs: support_uncertainty_state and exact associated limits/negatives where governed
TEMPORAL_OBSERVATION.producer_replay_locator_or_reference_roo: exact object ref + temporal_key_ref + admission_ref + authority_closure_refs
TEMPORAL_OBSERVATION.source_relation_comparability_authority_: only if selected operation declares them; exact dereference, never inferred
TEMPORAL_OBSERVATION.v553_object_content_hash: exported ref.content_hash; resolved object semantic_hash also verified

TEMPORAL_RELATION.applicable_temporal_limit_negative_refs: relation result/support state + exact TEMPORAL_LIMIT refs that govern requested relation
TEMPORAL_RELATION.focal_structural_proposition_ref: immutable dereference through participant admission refs; all rule-relevant propositions remain explicit
TEMPORAL_RELATION.native_scope_identity_refs: participant key/admission dereference; no scope relabeling
TEMPORAL_RELATION.originating_structural_empirical_admissi: participants -> exact temporal/admission refs -> originating admissions
TEMPORAL_RELATION.producer_replay_locator_or_reference_roo: exact relation ref + ordered participants + authority_closure_refs
TEMPORAL_RELATION.rule_relevant_temporal_semantic_refs: this relation ref + ordered/role-qualified participants + all required support refs
TEMPORAL_RELATION.v553_object_content_hash: exported ref.content_hash; resolved object semantic_hash also verified

v553_to_v554_projection.resolution_rule: Every SCR554 V553 consumer slot is satisfied either directly or by immutable object_id+content_hash dereference through SCR553 admission/participant/authority closure. No label/fuzzy/latest reconstruction.
